record_type: English summary transcribed from source report
pi_output_clamp: max_tokens = min(maxTokens, max(1, contextWindow - estimated_context - 4096)); the 4096 reserve is on top of the output
consequence: With a 32768 window the output shrinks above about 26.6k prompt tokens and reaches 1 token near 28.7k, which explains the earlier ~28.5k ceiling.
window_rule: A usable prompt P needs a window of at least P + 4096 + expected output; a 36864 window leaves a 1-token output (clamp floor) for a 32768 prompt.
limits: One run per configuration, short, no soak. Pi default reserveTokens 16384 would trigger compaction near 22.8k with this window.
